future_unseen_rule: No historical block is claimed untouched for this redesign. A separate frozen deployment protocol and predictions committed before their target start are required; later time alone is not pristine evidence.
walk_forward: expanding; scaler and fit see only s+h<=t; validation labels used for selection must end by validation_end
macro_measurement_note: WALCL and WTREGEN have different measurement conventions. They enter separately, not as a claimed synchronous liquidity balance. Original 39-feature experiment is preserved.
risk_event: minimum future daily LOW relative to origin daily CLOSE <= -0.05 at 7d or <= -0.10 at 30d; not a trading strategy
selection: No automatic winner or ensemble; record every variant and all failures. No promotion from this experiment.
comparison: pairwise identical forecast-origin and target sets; paired ablation also identical training-row sets; disclose coverage losses
missing_values: never fill missing funding/flows with zero; preserve calendar grid; source failure separate from absent coverage
multiple_testing: diagnostic intervals only, not promotion p-values; all attempts logged; no selected winner
source_upgrade_rule: Corrected raw derivatives are a different diagnostic dataset, never replacement of old frozen results. Data coverage must be reported before fitting. No paid provider acquisition.
